name: Jay Fai
address: 327 Maha Chai Road, Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok
dinnerNote: À la carte street food; typical spend THB 600–1,000
dinnerNoteTh: สตรีทฟู้ดแบบสั่งตามเมนู ค่าใช้จ่ายโดยทั่วไป 600–1,000 บาท
lunchNoteTh: เปิดมื้อกลางวัน · พ.–ส.
queue: Tables go to a walk-in list: arrive well before opening to put a name down, then come back and wait, often for an hour or more. Orders are taken while you queue, and everyone in the party has to be there. It's cash only.
duration: Open Wednesday to Saturday, about 9am to 7:30pm; closed Sunday to Tuesday. Check the restaurant's Instagram (@jayfaibangkok) for closures before going.
photoAlt: The plain tiled dining room of Raan Jay Fai, Bangkok
